QuestInfo.name: [Gold Beach] Little Troublemaker
QuestInfo.0: Little Richie barged in while you were talking to #p1082000#. See what he has to say.
QuestInfo.1: Have #p1082000# write a report on the resort's current status.

0.0: Lil Willy is resting soundly in his hyperbaric nap tank. Why are you two just standing around?

yes.0: Really! I guess it's just time for ME to do all the work. As a representative of Gold Beach Resort, you are going to tell #p1082000# to write me a report on our current status. No less than 300 pages.

no.0: Is it something I shouldn't know about?

1.0: Did that pinheaded little bag of marbles say something? I'm tired of his meddling...

yes.0: A report? That little gomba can't even read! You know, I used to work for Gold Richie. Now...

npc.0: Still haven't delivered my message? Tell #p1082000# to write the report. I want to know everything!
